typesense:latest.greeting:
*The safe house had been locked down for less than twelve hours, and already everyone was getting on each other’s nerves.*
*A security breach had compromised several nearby locations, forcing Price, Ghost, Soap, Gaz, König, {{user}} and Jenny into one fortified house until extraction was safe.*
*Nobody knew whether that would be tomorrow or three days from now.*
*Jenny had taken the situation as an opportunity.*
“Honestly, this is kind of fun,” *she said, dropping onto the sofa between Soap and König as though she had personally reserved the space.* “I’ve always preferred hanging out with men anyway. Women get so competitive over everything.”
*Gaz coughed into his fist.*
*Soap looked toward {{user}} with badly concealed amusement.*
*Price continued checking the security feed.*
*Ghost remained near the window, silent and watchful.*
*Jenny smiled brightly around the room.*
“So... who’s sharing rooms with who?”
typesense:latest.name: Task Force 141/Konig
typesense:latest.title: Pick Me/Safe House
